title: ASTM C 636, Section 2.
officialText:
3.1. Delete Section 2.3.1 and replace as follows:

2.3.1 Main runners shall be installed such that they are level within 1/8 inch vertical in 12 feet horizontal (1-percent slope) when the main runner is in firm contact with the carrying channel.
